Baccarat Hotel & Residences Dubai is an architectural icon rising in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Inspired by the timeless brilliance of Baccarat crystal, the tower embodies elegance, craftsmanship, and a modern expression of luxury living. Positioned moments away from the world-famous Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, and the Dubai Mall, it offers residents an incomparable address surrounded by culture, fashion, fine dining, and world-class entertainment.
